enrichment.headline: Final approval of the 2021-22 labor agreement with the Alameda County Building & Construction Trades Council
enrichment.summary: The Board gives final approval to a tentative agreement between the district and the Building & Construction Trades Council of Alameda County for the 2021-22 fiscal year. The item includes the county office of education's letter on public disclosure of labor agreements and the district's public disclosure and certification of cost, but the text states no dollar amount.

vendor.name: Building & Construction Trades Council of Alameda County

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Agreement - Oakland Unified School District and the Building & Construction Trades Council of Alameda County - 2021-2022 Fiscal Year (Final Adoption)

enrichment.headline: Adopts one-time off-schedule payments and salary adjustments for some unrepresented employees
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution approving one-time payments outside the regular salary schedule, plus salary schedule adjustments, effective July 1, 2022. It covers unrepresented substitute and hourly employees, confidential employees, and employees with employment contracts. The text states no dollar amounts.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
